summary: Polygon's guide offers two Diablo 4 season 2 Sorcerer builds: a Lightning-based Chain Lightning leveling build (from Lexyu at IcyVeins) and a Firewall endgame build (from Northwar at MaxRoll.gg). It lists skill orders, Enchantment slots, Legendary Aspects, Vampiric Powers, gear, and Paragon Board choices. It closes with advice on building around Lightning, Fire, or Ice and the Sorcerer's weak defenses.
one_line: Polygon guide to Diablo 4 season 2 Sorcerer builds: a Chain Lightning leveling build and a Firewall endgame build, plus general build advice.
key_facts: The leveling build is based on Lexyu's Sorcerer leveling guide at IcyVeins and covers allocating 58 skill points between levels 1 and 50.
The leveling build uses Chain Lightning as its Core skill, along with Frost Bolt, Teleport, Frost Nova, Lightning Spear, and Ice Armor.
Enchantment slots for leveling: Fireball at level 15 and Chain Lightning at level 30.
Leveling Aspects: Recharging Aspect (Zenith in Fractured Peaks), Aspect of Control (Sunken Library in Kehjistan), and Edgemaster's Aspect (Oldstones dungeon in Scosglen).
The endgame Firewall build is based on Northwar's Sorcerer endgame guide at MaxRoll.gg and assumes level 50+, all 58 skill points, and progress on Paragon Boards.
The Firewall build uses Firewall as its core skill, plus Fire Bolt, Inferno, Teleport, Ice Armor, and Flame Shield; its two Enchantment slots are Firewall and Fireball.
Season 2 adds 22 Vampiric Powers, which are class agnostic and let you slot five additional abilities.
Northwar recommends the Vampiric Powers Anticipation, Prey on the Weak, Ravenous, Flowing Veins, and Metamorphosis, requiring Pacts of 9 Ferocity, 5 Divinity, and 4 Eternity.
Recommended Firewall gear includes Godslayer Crown or Shared Misery (helm), Raiment of the Infinite or Snowveiled (chest), Disobedience (pants), and Control (amulet).
The Paragon Glyphs should be leveled to 15 in this order: Destruction, Control, Adept, Exploit, Reinforced.
The Sorcerer has six Key Passives but only three elements: Lightning, Fire, and Ice.
Sorcerers have the weakest defensive stats of any class and die very easily, so players should invest heavily in defensive skills.
